def count_vowels(s):
    """
    Counts the number of vowels in the string s using the ASCII code for each character. 
    Returns the count of vowels in the string.
    
    >>> count_vowels('aeiou')
    5
    >>> count_vowels('BANANAS')
    3
    >>> count_vowels('aBBBaR')
    5
    """
    return sum(s.count(v) for v in "aeiou" if v in s.lower())
